issue: r3.6-final-20261111 APK crashed on every Termux:X11 launch (SIGSEGV)
root_cause: The 00:29 finalize pass moved computeCursorOverlayRect() to the top of resendCursorOverlayBuffer(). resend is reached from refreshContext() -> ensureCursorOverlay() when the activity Surface arrives, before the X server has shared its state (state == nullptr); computeCursorOverlayRect dereferences state->cursor.width (offset 0x594) unconditionally.

crash_signature.signal: SIGSEGV SEGV_MAPERR, fault addr 0x594 (null pointer dereference)
frames: Renderer::computeCursorOverlayRect(int*, int*, unsigned int*, unsigned int*)+4

fix.summary: guard state and cursorOverlayRenderTarget in resendCursorOverlayBuffer(); defensive null-state return in computeCursorOverlayRect()

runtime_check.launch: am start -W: COLD, status ok, TotalTime 677 ms
runtime_check.note: X server was not running; launching the display app without a server shows a black screen, not a crash. Desktop session cold start not exercised here.
